title: Circuit query and accepting assignments
statement: Let $C$ be a fan-in-two Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, and let $q$ be a bit string. The query asking whether $C$ accepts $q$ holds exactly when there is an assignment $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ whose bit string, in order, is $q$ and on which $C$ evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a circuit with $n$ input bits
